title: Port OBJ, MTL and texture-set import
scope: OBJ geometry (polygons, negative indices, groups), the MTL library and texture references as the original resolves them, including the multi-file pick/drop set.
acceptance: Generated and adversarial OBJ/MTL corpus compares original against Rust on geometry, material and texture bindings, refusals and limits.
Image decoding is a separate, explicitly reviewed dependency decision (pure-Rust only) and is not assumed here.
open_items: Texture image decoding needs a recorded pure-Rust dependency decision (P35 purity audit).
